summary: This is a Git configuration file that sets up different email addresses for different directories. It establishes a default user identity, then uses a conditional rule to override the email specifically for repositories stored in a private folder.

explanations.5: The includeIf directive tells Git to apply the following settings only if a certain condition is met — in this case, only when the repository is located within the ~/private_repositories/ directory.
explanations.6: This email address will be used instead of the default one (me@work.be) whenever you commit in a repository that matches the directory condition above.
